memories.content: The geography department head has prepared the proposal for the coastal field trip, including a risk-assessment form that now requires an extra signature from the deputy head (who is on leave until late September). They want the principal to sign off before the half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters.

The coastal field trip has run without incident for four years. This year, a new coach operator is contracted, and the risk-assessment form requires an additional signature from the deputy head, who is on leave until late September. The half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters is approaching. The geography department head can submit the proposal to the principal for approval.
